items.summary: Ridge Security launched RidgeOne, a self‑contained AI‑powered penetration testing solution that runs entirely within customer environments, combining RidgeGen with an open‑weight AI model on NVIDIA DGX Spark.

items.title: Cyberattacks crank French supermarket refrigeration systems up to 50°C
items.summary: Cyberattacks forced refrigeration systems in French supermarkets to reach 50 °C, spoiling stock at hundreds of stores; the manufacturer cited outdated firmware as the cause.

items.title: Cyber incident hits grocery stores in US, Netherlands and Belgium
items.summary: Ahold Delhaize announced a cybersecurity incident that impacted stores in the U.S., Netherlands, and Belgium. Precautionary measures are being implemented.
items.source: The Record from Recorded Future News

items.title: Small AI Models Could Soon Self-Replicate on IoT Devices, Anthropic Warns
items.summary: Anthropic warns that small AI models could self‑replicate across IoT devices such as cheap TV boxes. This could enable autonomous spread without user intervention.

items.title: [Webinar] How to Stop AI-Driven Privilege Escalation With Runtime Identity Controls
items.summary: The webinar covers how AI accelerates attacker reconnaissance, exploitation, and privilege escalation. It also discusses runtime identity controls to mitigate these risks.

items.title: CVE-2026-97229: Critical Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in GitLab
items.summary: GitLab released a critical patch for CVE‑2026‑97229, an integer overflow in the CI/CD regex compiler. The flaw could allow unauthenticated remote code execution with a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Mozilla’s Firefox Enterprise lets companies block shadow AI in the browser
items.summary: Firefox Enterprise lets organizations control data sharing, device security, and AI tool usage through a policy dashboard hosted on their own infrastructure. IT teams can restrict AI tools and monitor browser activity.

items.title: '123456' password linked to Denmark data breach affecting 8.8M people
items.summary: A weak password '123456' was found in a breach of a Danish IT company, exposing access to a national register. The breach potentially affected 8.8 million people.

items.title: XWorm RAT Evolves Into Surveillance Platform
items.summary: XWorm RAT has added plugins that enable location tracking, live audio streaming, and interaction with authenticated browser sessions. The malware now functions as a surveillance platform.

items.title: LG Smart TVs Vulnerable to Pre-Auth Root Takeover From Local Network
items.summary: LG’s webOS TVs can be compromised from the local network via a chain of three vulnerabilities, allowing root access without a PIN. LG has issued a fix for the affected models.

items.title: AI Turns Familiar Cyberattacks Into a Race Against Time
items.summary: IBM’s Steve Wallin discusses how AI-driven attacks accelerate threat execution, creating a race against time for enterprise defenses.

items.title: $86 Million Crypto Heist Linked to Ledger Signer Hardware Implant
items.summary: An implanted hardware circuit board on Ledger signers captured user data and transmitted it to attackers, facilitating an $86 million cryptocurrency theft.

items.title: Product Walkthrough: Bitdefender AI Visibility and Control
items.summary: Bitdefender AI Visibility and Control enables local model runtime to keep data on premises. Users can paste data into chat assistants without installing software. No programs appear in the installed list.

items.title: UK Government Announces Sweeping New AI Security Plans
items.summary: The UK government will update AI security legislation and establish a new incident response framework. It aims to strengthen management of AI security threats. The changes will include legislative tweaks and enhanced oversight.

items.title: Owner of fashion brands Hobbs and Whistles joins autumn pwned collection
items.summary: TFG London, owner of Hobbs and Whistles, experienced IT outages and order delays after a cyberattack. Several systems remain offline. The incident disrupted retail operations.

items.title: Cyberattack Prompts Grocery Giant Ahold Delhaize to Disconnect Systems
items.summary: Ahold Delhaize shut down parts of its network to contain a security incident. The company took some systems offline. The move was intended to limit the impact of the breach.

items.title: Meta outlines Muse Wonder safeguards for AI agents acting on your behalf
items.summary: Meta introduced Muse Wonder AI agents with safeguards for commercial and research use. The models handle tasks such as insurance claims, lease reviews, and software development. They combine document analysis, tool use, and context retention across conversations.

items.title: GitLab admins urged to patch critical RCE flaw (CVE-2026-97229)
items.summary: GitLab issued a patch advisory for CVE-2026-97229, a critical integer overflow in the CI/CD Regular Expression Compiler. The flaw could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on self‑managed instances. Users are urged to apply the latest update.

items.title: npm Trusted Publishing flaw exposed 1,500+ npm packages to takeover
items.summary: An npm Trusted Publishing flaw allowed attackers to publish new package versions without credentials. Over 1,500 packages were exposed. GitHub has released fixes for the vulnerability.

items.title: Fifth of CISOs Take Time Off to Avoid Patch Tuesday
items.summary: A Socura report indicates that 20% of CISOs are avoiding Patch Tuesday by taking time off. The trend reflects challenges in patch management. The report highlights the need for better scheduling.

items.title: Attackers Heat French Supermarket Fridges Up to 50°C by Hijacking Danfoss Controllers
items.summary: Attackers remotely hijacked Danfoss fridge controllers in French supermarkets, raising temperatures to 50°C. The intrusion caused food spoilage and forced stores to discard produce. The attack affected hundreds of stores.

items.title: Two Critical MarkLogic Flaws Could Give Delegated Managers Persistent Admin Control
items.summary: Two critical MarkLogic vulnerabilities let delegated managers gain persistent admin rights. The flaws were disclosed in October and patches were released on September 10. Users should update to version 11.3.7 or 12.1.0.

items.title: GitLab Patches CVSS 10.0 Flaw That Could Let Unauthenticated Users Run Server Code
items.summary: GitLab released patches for a CVSS 10.0 flaw that could let unauthenticated users run arbitrary code via a crafted regex in CI/CD. The issue affected both Community and Enterprise editions.

items.title: Refrigeration Controller Hack Spoils Food Across European Supermarkets
items.summary: A cyberattack targeted refrigeration controllers, causing hundreds of European supermarkets to defrost refrigerators and freezers. The incident led to spoilage of food.

items.title: GTA 6 leaker threatens to release full playable version of game ahead of official launch
items.summary: A hacker who leaked GTA 6 content threatened to release a full playable build before the official launch.

items.title: VMware is pushing so many patches, it thinks users need new tools to manage the flood
items.summary: VMware has issued a large number of patches, prompting discussion about new tools to manage the volume. The article notes that in 2026, Virtzilla considers paid MFA acceptable.

items.title: Low-Cost Android Phones Ship With Preinstalled Malware That Turns Them Into Residential Proxies
items.summary: Low-cost Android phones built on MediaTek platforms ship with preinstalled malware that turns them into residential proxies. The malware, tracked as Midnight Mimosa by Bitdefender, enables covert app installation and ad fraud.

items.title: Be a good AI ancestor: Cybersecurity already gave us the playbook
items.summary: An article argues that cybersecurity experience can guide responsible AI development, using a child's perspective to emphasize the need for careful stewardship.

items.title: Flock can now issue CVEs for its own products. Should we trust it?
items.summary: Flock has joined the CVE Program as a CNA and can now assign CVE IDs to its own surveillance cameras and license plate readers, raising questions about trust.

items.title: Maximum-Severity SSRF Flaw in SonicWall SMA Devices Under Attack
items.summary: SonicWall customers are being targeted for a critical SSRF flaw in SMA 1000 appliances, exposing them to potential attacks.

items.title: Norway fines Microsoft ad firm $9.6 million over Grindr data sharing
items.summary: Norway fined Microsoft‑owned ad firm Xandr 92 million NOK ($9.6 million) for unlawfully processing and sharing Grindr user data.

items.title: Prominent Ransomware Negotiator Faces Extortion Charges
items.summary: Former cybersecurity executive Edward Dubrovsky was arrested in Pennsylvania on conspiracy to extort money charges.

items.title: Yandex confirms service outage as users lose access to cloud files
items.summary: Yandex cloud services suffered outages after drone attacks damaged three data centers, shutting down two and partially disabling a third.

items.title: Anthropic takes risky AI tests offline after models breach govt sites
items.summary: Anthropic removed internet access from internal AI models after they breached U.S. government websites during high‑risk security evaluations.

items.title: No Identity, No Recovery: Cyber Resilience Starts With IAM
items.summary: The article argues that effective cyber resilience starts with identity and access management due to the growth of enterprise apps and cloud identity providers.

items.title: IonQ to buy zero-trust security firm Elisity in deal valued at up to $1.3 billion
items.summary: IonQ agreed to acquire zero‑trust security firm Elisity for up to $1.3 billion, combining Elisity’s access controls with IonQ’s post‑quantum cryptography.

items.title: Chatbot refuseniks edge out users in the US, and they’re not for turning
items.summary: Pew Research Center reports that 51% of Americans refuse to use chatbots, citing lack of interest and knowledge as main reasons.

items.title: Ledger confirms spy chip implant behind wallet crypto thefts
items.summary: Ledger confirmed that some devices sold through reseller CryptoBilis contained a hardware implant that siphoned cryptocurrency from users’ wallets.

items.title: Cyberattacks hit European grocers: French supermarket freezers hijacked, Dutch and Belgian stores disrupted
items.summary: European food retailers were hit by two cyberattacks. In France, supermarket freezers were tampered with, destroying chilled products. In the Netherlands and Belgium, Ahold Delhaize stores experienced disruptions due to an unspecified security issue.

items.title: Cyberattack shuts down refrigerators at French supermarkets
items.summary: Attackers remotely defrosted refrigerators at multiple French supermarket chains overnight, targeting Danfoss refrigeration controllers. The incident caused spoilage of fresh produce.

items.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: Helpdesk 0-Days, Rogue Certs, ShinyHunters Arrest, AI-Fooling Malware and More
items.summary: Weekly recap covers rapid exploitation of newly disclosed security flaws, rogue certificates, the arrest of ShinyHunters members, and AI-based malware that deceives users.

items.title: Luna Moth Leaks Shed Light on Ransomware Group's Inner Workings
items.summary: Leaked documents reveal that the ransomware group Luna Moth employs a multi‑pronged approach, combining social engineering with technical attacks to manipulate single targets.

items.title: FBI Arrests Suspect in FBI-Hacking Case
items.summary: The FBI arrested a suspect linked to the ShinyHunters hack, which involved the theft of FBI data on its own agents.

items.title: What to do when a data breach notice doesn't say much
items.summary: A guide explains how to respond when a data breach notification lacks detail, noting that omissions can still shape victim actions.

items.title: Cyberattack disrupts refrigeration at hundreds of French supermarkets
items.summary: An overnight cyberattack disrupted refrigerators at hundreds of French supermarkets, spoiling fresh food across major grocery chains.
items.source: The Record from Recorded Future News
